components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9+() ]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered. Defaults to the current server date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners at the same address with the same last name.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived duplicate-detection key, formatted '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole keys match.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|owner@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of owners that existed before this one sharing the same first and last name (case-insensitive).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "A numeric membership level from 1 to 3: starts at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners were already created on this owner's registration date, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another owner shares this owner's last name and postcode but has a different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this one possibly duplicates (same last name and postcode, different telephone), absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when birthDate is not supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: country code, a space, then national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Raw 'telephone' stays E.164."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## What I did

Replaced the membership-level rules with a points system, exposing both `membershipPoints` and `membershipLevel`.

**Points** (start at 0): +2 email present · +1 `namesakeCount == 0` · +2 household of 3+ · +3 tenure over 365 days.
**Level** maps points: 1 (0–1), 2 (2–3), 3 (4–5), 4 (6+).

## Files touched (4)

- `MembershipLevel.java` — rewrote into two small pure functions: `points(owner, namesakeCount, householdSize)` and `level(points)` (a one-line `Math.min(points / 2 + 1, 4)`). Reused the existing `hasTenure` helper.
- `RespondWithOwner.java` / `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` — compute points (reusing the existing `Household.size(...)` helper for household size), set both DTO fields. ~3 changed lines each, each in a single-method class (WMC_other = 0).

## Structural-impact notes

The behavior lives in `MembershipLevel`, a tiny standalone class, so no large class's WMC is dragged in. The two responder edits are trivial and touch single-method classes. The mapping is a closed-form expression rather than a branchy ladder, keeping CC low.

The acceptance test (`membershipPoints=3`, `membershipLevel=2` for a fresh owner with email, no namesake, single-member household, zero tenure) and the full suite pass — `BUILD SUCCESS`.
